title: helianthemum marifolium subsp. molle
intro: Helianthemum marifolium subsp. molle, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species within the family Cistaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum marifolium subsp. molle include anti-bacterial, anti-fungal, and anti-viral properties, making it a potential remedy for various infections and conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
